**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate the target before screen-frame capture**

When `frame="screen_physical_px"`, `capture()` never calls `_target()`, so this new public observation hook returns a successful capture even if `target` is unknown or its registered HWND is stale. Program-driven captures validate the target during focus/preflight, but `observe_in_session()` reaches this method directly; therefore read-only observations can incorrectly succeed after the target binding has vanished. Validate the registered target here before delegating, for both supported frames.
